text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite being in the Classic Class, Oguri 
Cap brilliantly earned her spot in the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even she showed a hint of nervousness 
right before the race, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The passion, the cheers, and the 
excitement she witnessed in the stands 
last year. She resolved to claim all of it 
for herself.
